snippet.title: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y — DLC 2: Awakening of a Soul | Latest Update
snippet.description:
Another brave soul awakens…
 
SUPER ROBOT WARS Y — DLC 2 “Awakening of a Soul” launches Early Access on Feb 3 (PT) and General Access on Feb 5 (PT).
 
Plus, Free Update Patch v1.2.0 drops Feb 2 (PT).
 
Official Site: https://spr.ly/60577VrEN
